name: Neil Gilmour
role: Receiver of the Bismarck land office
bio: Neil Gilmour was receiver of the Bismarck land office. He visited Medora in June 1885 and again in October 1885.

moments.label: Visited Medora as receiver of the land office

mentions: Hon. E. A. Williams, and Neil Gilmour of the Bismarck Land office were in town Wednesday.
Receiver Gilmour of the Bismarck land office, was in Medora last week.
Arrivals at the Northern Pacific during the last week were as follows:  Neil Gilmour Bismarck; Dr Heber Robarts Dickinson C [illegible] Hood Mandan; Jack White W H Minty City; J L Truscott, ranch.
